splash1: Exciting tumble feature for consecutive wins
Ticker1: Winning combinations pay on adjacent reels from left to right.
Ticker2: Multiplier symbols may increase the value of wins.
Ticker3: Winning symbols are removed and replaced by new symbols.
Ticker4: 4 or more Scatter symbols trigger the Free Spins feature.
Ticker5: During Free Spins, collected multipliers are added together.
WDpayoutContent: Wild substitutes all symbols except Scatter
gameText: Play Empire of Gold, a 6×5 slot game where matching symbols anywhere on the grid can win you rewards.
tumbleFeature1: The TUMBLE FEATURE pays out winning combinations after each spin, then removes the winning symbols from the grid. The remaining symbols drop down to fill the gaps, while new symbols fall in from above to replace the empty spaces.
tumbleFeature2: This tumbling process repeats as long as new winning combinations are created, with no limit to the number of possible tumbles. All winnings are credited to the player’s balance once every tumble triggered by the original spin has finished.
multiplierSymbols2: Each Multiplier is randomly assigned a value between 2x and 500x.
multiplierSymbols3: Once the tumbling sequence concludes, all Multiplier values visible on the screen are summed and used to multiply the total win of the sequence.
freeSpins1: Unlock the Free Spins Bonus by landing 4 or more SCATTER symbols.
freeSpins2: Start with 15 free spins, and 3 or more SCATTERs during the bonus round to give you 5 extra spins.
freeSpins3: During the Free Spins round, you might see special symbols called Multipliers.
freeSpins4: When a Multiplier appears, it picks a random number like 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 8x, 10x, 12x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, or 500x.
freeSpins5: After all the falling stops, the game adds all the Multipliers you collected and uses that total to boost your win from that spin.
freeSpins6: Special reels are active during Free Spins, which can give you better chances.
anteBet2: 25x Bet Multiplier: Boost Your Wins with the 25x Bet Multiplier. Enjoy a higher chance of landing Scatters as extra symbols appear on the reels. (BUY FREE SPINS is unavailable in this mode.)
gameRule3: After every spin, winning clusters are paid and their symbols disappear. New symbols drop into the empty spaces, and this cycle repeats until no further wins appear. Once the sequence ends, the total payout from that spin is credited to the player.
winGameText1: Wins are triggered by matching at least 8 or more same symbols shown anywhere on the screen after a spin.
winGameText2: All wins are multiplied by base bet.The greater the count, the higher the payout.
maxwiDesc1: In both the base game and Free Spins, the most you can win is 5,000 times your bet.
maxwiDesc2: If you reach this limit during Free Spins, the game will end the round immediately, give you the prize, and cancel any spins you had left.
paytable1: Landing 4 or more scatter symbols activates the bonus round, awarding 15 free spins.
paytable2: During these spins, any multiplier symbol that appears on a winning spin is added to a cumulative multiplier and applied to the payout.
scatterContent: The SCATTER symbol appears on all reels. It can land in any position and still award a payout.
multiplierSymbols1: Multiplier symbols can appear on any reel during spins and tumbles in both the base game and Free Spins.
multiplierSymbols4: The landed multiplier only applies to the cluster win value.
